steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Space Age began with Sputnik 1 (1957), the first artificial satellite | Key Fact: The Apollo programme (1969–1972) landed 12 humans on the Moon; Apollo 11 was the first | Key Fact: The International Space Station (ISS) has been continuously occupied since 2000 | Key Fact: Voyager 1 and 2 (launched 1977) are the most distant human-made objects, now in interstellar space

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from space exploration &amp; missions, and one past-paper question.
